items.title: Carbon storage and mitigation potential of structural wood and biochar-based concrete in global urban building scenarios
items.title_en: Carbon storage and mitigation potential of structural wood and biochar-based concrete in global urban building scenarios
items.title_zh: 在全球城市建筑场景下，结构用木材和生物炭基混凝土的碳封存与减排潜力
items.summary_en: Urbanization is accelerating globally, increasing material demand and associated greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Bio-based construction materials can store biogenic carbon within buildings over long periods, yet their net climate change mitigation potential, interaction with circular strategies, and feasibility remain uncertain. Here, we assess biogenic carbon storage and net embodied GHG emissions in global urban building stocks between 2020 and 2100 under material substitution scenarios including structural wood and biochar-based concrete at substitution levels of 10%, 30% and 50%. We further explore the mitigation potential of combining these substitution scenarios with sufficiency and circular economy strategies that reduce floor space demand and material flows. We account for biogenic carbon inflows and outflows, embodied emissions, and feasibility considerations. We find that substituting conventional construction systems with structural wood results in cumulative net carbon storage of 11.0–24.8 GtCO2eq by 2100. These scenarios reduce cumulative net embodied GHG emissions by 20–100 GtCO2eq (−8% to −40%) compared to current construction practices, due to both lower embodied emissions and higher net carbon storage associated. In contrast, substituting with biochar-based concrete achieves more limited cumulative net carbon storage of 7.9–14.5 GtCO2eq and reduces cumulative net embodied emissions by up to 8 GtCO2eq (−4%), constrained by feasible substitution rates in cement needed to maintain structural performance. Combining material substitutions with sufficiency and circular strategies delivers the greatest mitigation potential, lowering cumulative net embodied emissions by up to 64% for wood and 41% for biochar by 2100. Achieving the full carbon storage potential without complementary sufficiency and circular strategies would require substantial expansion of biochar supply, while the feasibility of wood-based storage depends strongly on the level of material substitution. These findings clarify the potential, limits, and feasibility of biogenic carbon storage in urban buildings worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 全球城市化进程正在加速，这导致材料需求及相关温室气体（GHG）排放量增加。生物基建筑材料可在建筑物内长期储存生物源碳，但其净减缓气候变化的潜力、与循环经济策略的互动以及可行性仍存在不确定性。 本文评估了2020年至2100年间，在全球城市建筑存量中，采用结构用木材和生物炭混凝土作为替代材料的不同情景下（替代比例分别为10%、30%和50%）的生物源碳储存量及净隐含温室气体排放量。 我们进一步探讨了将这些替代方案与能够减少建筑面积需求和材料流的“适足”及循环经济策略相结合时的减排潜力。研究中考虑了生物源碳的流入与流出、隐含排放以及可行性因素。 研究发现，用结构木材替代传统建筑系统，到2100年可实现11.0–24.8 GtCO2eq的累计净碳储存。 与当前建筑实践相比，这些方案可使累计净隐含温室气体排放减少 20–100 GtCO2eq（−8% 至 −40%），这既得益于隐含排放的降低，也源于相关的净碳储存量增加。 相比之下，采用生物炭混凝土替代所能实现的累计净碳储存量则较为有限，为 7.9–14.5 GtCO2eq，且累计净隐含排放量最多可减少 8 GtCO2eq（−4%），其减排幅度受限于为维持结构性能而必须保持的水泥替代率。 将材料替代与充足性及循环利用策略相结合，可带来最大的减排潜力：到2100年，木材的累计净隐含排放量最多可降低64%，生物炭的累计净隐含排放量最多可降低41%。 若无配套的“适足”和“循环”策略，要实现全部碳储存潜力，则需要大幅扩大生物炭供应；而基于木材的碳储存可行性则在很大程度上取决于材料使用水平。

items.title: No net carbon recovery in logged tropical forests in central Vietnam
items.title_en: No net carbon recovery in logged tropical forests in central Vietnam
items.title_zh: 越南中部已采伐的热带森林中未出现净碳回收
items.summary_en: Tropical forests recovering from logging are widely assumed to rapidly accumulate carbon. However, in Southeast Asia, where a legacy of high-intensity logging and climate change may modulate recovery trajectories, uncertainties remain about the rate and spatial heterogeneity of aboveground biomass recovery and the long-term stability of the forest carbon sink. Here we show no evidence of net aboveground carbon accumulation in naturally regenerating, selectively logged forests in central Vietnam. Based on the repeated inventories of 24 permanent plots (2016–2024) nearly two decades after 25 years of logging ceased, net carbon uptake was indistinguishable from zero (0.004 Mg C ha−1 yr−1, 95% CI: −0.38, 0.38). Higher maximum temperatures were strongly associated with reduced carbon gains, suggesting that warming may already be constraining forest productivity. Observed recovery rates are significantly lower than the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change benchmarks and previously reported rates for Southeast Asian forests. Our results challenge the assumption of rapid and predictable carbon recovery in degraded tropical forests. Nevertheless, these forests maintained existing carbon stocks throughout monitoring, with no detectable net carbon loss. Carbon assessment frameworks that do not incorporate local data risk overestimating sequestration potential. Consequently, site-specific, long-term data are essential for calibrating restoration strategies, improving carbon estimates and informing climate mitigation policies in a warming world.
items.summary_zh: 人们普遍认为，从采伐中恢复的热带森林能够迅速积累碳。然而，在东南亚地区，由于过去曾进行过高强度采伐，加之气候变化的影响可能改变森林的恢复轨迹，因此关于地上生物量恢复的速度和空间异质性，以及森林碳汇的长期稳定性，仍存在诸多不确定性。 本文表明，在越南中部的自然更新、曾进行过选择性采伐的森林中，未发现地上碳净积累的证据。 基于24个永久样地（2016–2024年）的重复清查数据——这些样地位于采伐停止25年后近二十年的区域——净碳吸收量与零无异（0.004 Mg C ha−1 yr−1，95% CI：−0.38， 0.38）。最高气温的升高与碳增量的减少呈显著正相关，表明变暖可能已经开始制约森林生产力。观测到的恢复速率显著低于政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）的基准值以及此前报道的东南亚森林恢复速率。我们的研究结果对退化热带森林中碳恢复迅速且可预测这一假设提出了质疑。 尽管如此，这些森林在整个监测期间维持了现有的碳储量，未检测到净碳损失。未纳入本地数据的碳评估框架可能导致碳封存潜力的高估。因此，在气候变暖的背景下，针对具体地点的长期数据对于校准生态恢复策略、改进碳估算以及为气候减缓政策提供依据至关重要。

items.title: Irrigation’s climate benefit could equal 363 years of its own emissions
items.title_en: Irrigation’s climate benefit could equal 363 years of its own emissions
items.title_zh: 灌溉带来的气候效益可能相当于其自身363年的排放量
items.summary_en: U.S. irrigation produces some greenhouse gas emissions, but new research suggests it prevents vastly more by allowing farmers to grow more food on less land. Without irrigation, replacing lost crop yields could require converting natural ecosystems into farmland, releasing an estimated 6.86 gigatons of greenhouse gases. That is equivalent to about 363 years of current annual U.S. irrigation emissions.
items.summary_zh: 美国的灌溉会产生一些温室气体排放，但最新研究表明，通过让农民在更少的土地上种植更多粮食，灌溉实际上避免了数量远超其排放量的温室气体排放。 如果没有灌溉，为了弥补作物减产造成的损失，可能需要将自然生态系统转化为农田，预计将因此释放6.86吉吨的温室气体。这相当于美国当前灌溉年排放量的约363倍。

items.title: Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting from a Pitch-Plunge Aerofoil in Compressible Flow, the Euler Full-Order Model, Strip Theory and the Reduced Models Compared
items.title_en: Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting from a Pitch-Plunge Aerofoil in Compressible Flow, the Euler Full-Order Model, Strip Theory and the Reduced Models Compared
items.title_zh: 可压缩流中俯仰-俯冲翼型的压电能量 harvesting：欧拉全阶模型、条带理论与简化模型的比较
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.18601v1 An: new Abstract: A piezoelectric transducer embedded in a pitch-plunge aerofoil with a finite-mass trailingedge flap converts the limit-cycle oscillation that follows flutter into electrical power. The design findings for such a harvester have so far been obtained with incompressible strip theory, whose aerodynamic state is a handful of lag variables. Here the same section, the same transducer and the same test cases are coupled instead to the two-dimensional compressible Euler equations, giving a full-order model of twelve thousand states, and the two aerodynamic models are placed side by side on the flutter boundary, on the limit cycle and on the harvested power, with the strip-theory results compared against higher fidelity aerodynamic modelling provided by CFD. The degree of freedom carrying the transducer remains the first-order design variable, and the ranking of the mountings is unchanged and wider, while strip theory is found to under-predict the harvested power of the compressible section and to overstate the effect of the transducer on stability where the electrical time constant meets the flutter frequency. items.summary: arXiv:2609.18601v1 An: new Abstract: A piezoelectric transducer embedded in a pitch-plunge aerofoil with a finite-mass trailingedge flap converts the limit-cycle oscillation that follows flutter into electrical power. The design findings for such a harvester have so far been obtained with incompressible strip theory, whose aerodynamic state is a handful of lag variables. Here the same section, the same transducer and the same test cases are coupled instead to the two-dimensional compressible Euler equations, giving a full-order model of twelve thousand states, and the two aerodynamic models are placed side by side on the flutter boundary, on the limit cycle and on the harvested power, with the strip-theory results compared against higher fidelity aerodynamic modelling provided by CFD. The degree of freedom carrying the transducer remains the first-order design variable, and the ranking of the mountings is unchanged and wider, while strip theory is found to under-predict the harvested power of the compressible section and to overstate the effect of the transducer on stability where the electrical time constant meets the flutter frequency.
